_what: Daily XLMUSDT closes, the input to check-params.ts's realized-volatility measurement.
It is a file rather than a constant in the script because D-53's finding was that a hard-coded
sigma band was wrong by a factor of two at the low end, and every parameter derived from it was
wrong with it - the five planned vaults priced at 7.3 bps against a 28 bps floor, none of them
fillable by a rational counterparty. A committed series is also auditable: a reviewer can see
This is a point-in-time measurement, like deployments/environment-testnet.json. Re-fetch before
a real deploy; check-params.ts reads whatever series it is given and does not know how old this
